AppConfig.title: AppConfig
AppConfig.description: Live cloud-synced game configuration published by the Admin Portal (ads, ad slots, live score link, and game speed settings).

adsJson.description: Serialized JSON array of active sponsor ads.

slotsJson.description: Serialized JSON object of ad slot toggles.

liveScoreJson.description: Serialized JSON object of live scoring site link settings.

gameSettingsJson.description: Serialized JSON object of game speed and character settings.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last live publish.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who published the config.

/app_config/{docId}.description: Singleton live configuration document at /app_config/live readable by all players and writable only by the verified admin.
